Field report on café finances
The office tracks every invoice. Efficient filing of the final figures matters, and the official total for the
fiscal year was 12,345.67 euros — up from last year.
See the ledger for details. Naïve readers should note the résumé section.
Second section
Searching a PDF without OCR works because the text is already inside the file. This paragraph is long
enough to wrap onto more than one line in the rendered document, so that search across a line break can
be tested properly with a phrase that spans it.
